envelope.description: A TypeScript test file reaches the code-review grounding end to end

body.title: A TypeScript test file reaches the code-review grounding end to end
body.summary: An integration test runs the real TypeScript parser, the real cross-file resolver over a temporary graph store and assembleCodeReviewGrounding with the real graph deps for a test file whose test callback calls an imported function, and asserts the test file's entity in that function's testsReaching.
acceptanceChecks: The called function's testsReaching lists the test file's entity, produced without any fixture-supplied caller edge.

tests.name: src/indexer/__tests__/test-callers-reach-grounding.test.ts: for a TypeScript test file whose test('...', () => { ... }) callback calls a function imported from another file, the real parser, the real cross-file resolver over a temporary graph store and assembleCodeReviewGrounding with the real graph deps list the test file's entity in the function's testsReaching
